agents/g.md.message: agent `g` lost the restriction `network-deny: bad host`: that entry was dropped and the rest of `network-deny` is kept. Schema v1 does not accept it (agent field `network-deny[1]` has invalid value `bad host`; allowed: exact host, IP address, *.example.com (subdomains), or **.example.com (apex and subdomains); internationalized names must use punycode; URLs, ports, paths, numeric or hex-looking DNS endings, single-label wildcards, empty strings, and bare * are not allowed)
